description: Commit a patch to a branch without sending whole files — the way to change a few lines of a large file. `patch` is a unified diff as `git diff` prints it (one commit, `message` required) OR `git format-patch` mbox output (each patch becomes its own commit with the patch's own message and author, like `git am`; `message` is ignored). Applied server-side with `git apply --cached` against the branch head (created from `base_branch` if missing); `expected_head_sha` makes it compare-and-swap (all zeros = branch must not exist yet). Meets the same branch protection, rulesets and secret scan as a git push, and fires CI/webhooks like one. Patch limit 2 MiB. Requires 'repo' scope. Returns {branch, commit_sha, parent_sha, files_changed, files, commits, created}.

base_branch.description: Branch to fork from when `branch` does not exist yet (default: the repo's default branch).

branch.description: Target branch (short name). Created if it does not exist.

expected_head_sha.description: Optional compare-and-swap: the 40-hex sha you expect `branch` to point at. Refused if it moved. All zeros = the branch must not exist.

message.description: Commit message. Required for a unified diff; ignored for mbox input (each patch carries its own).

patch.description: Unified diff (`git diff`, a/ b/ prefixes) or `git format-patch` mbox text. Max 2 MiB.

name: gluecron_apply_patch
